status_note: Candidate contracts, NOT part of locked Factor Contract v1. No alpha claims. Every entry is NOT_VALIDATED. VALIDATION_STATUS here adds the value NOT_VALIDATED to lifecycle_fields.json (that file is unchanged); promotion requires validation_kernel evidence per docs/research/NEW_FACTOR_CANDIDATES_20261011.md, and Vector cannot self-certify.

candidates.name: Gross Profitability (GP/A)
candidates.formula: GrossProfit / TotalAssets, GrossProfit = Revenue - COGS (profit over assets, not gross margin); latest statement with known_at <= as_of, same period_end, period_type annual by default

inputs.source: SEC EDGAR XBRL (US) / exchange filings via CNINFO (CN)

candidates.pit_rule: restated values are new facts with their own known_at; max staleness 548 days else MISSING; known_at is a timezone-aware datetime; version selection by (known_at, revision) with AmbiguousVersionError on unresolved conflicts
candidates.missing_rule: any missing input, non-positive assets, or NaN => None; never 0. Financials/banks without COGS stay MISSING
candidates.data_gaps: No vendor-grade PIT fundamentals ingested in repo yet; CN COGS definition varies (营业成本)
candidates.definition_status: Gross-profit-over-assets is the standard definition; Novy-Marx (2013) full text NOT read in this repo (UNVERIFIED against paper)

candidates.name: Balance-sheet Accruals (Sloan)
candidates.formula: ((dCA - dCash) - (dCL - dSTD - dTP) - DepAmort) / avg(TA_t, TA_t-1); DepAmort = depreciation and amortization expense, subtracted

inputs.field: current_assets, cash, current_liabilities, short_term_debt, tax_payable, depreciation_amortization, total_assets (current and prior fiscal year)
inputs.source: SEC EDGAR XBRL (US) / CNINFO exchange filings (CN)
inputs.known_at: filing acceptance datetime (US) / announcement date (CN); both years must be visible at as_of

candidates.pit_rule: both statements must have known_at <= as_of; prior-year period must be 300-430 days before current; known_at is a timezone-aware datetime; version selection by (known_at, revision) with AmbiguousVersionError on unresolved conflicts
candidates.missing_rule: any component missing in either year => None; tax_payable / short_term_debt are NOT zero-filled
candidates.direction_hypothesis: higher accruals => lower expected return (hypothesis only)
candidates.data_gaps: Strict missing rule will drop many names where XBRL tags are absent; CN balance sheets lack a clean tax-payable/STD split in some vendors
candidates.definition_status: VERIFIED against Sloan (1996) full text (JSTOR scan); XBRL mapping of income-taxes-payable and debt-in-current-liabilities UNVERIFIED

candidates.name: MAX lottery demand
candidates.formula: PRIMARY (variant prior_calendar_month): max daily return within the previous calendar month; ALTERNATIVE (variant fixed_21_trading_days, not the paper's definition): max over trailing 21 trading days. >= 15 valid days (project choice)

inputs.source: licensed daily price vendor (US) / exchange-derived adjusted prices (CN)
inputs.known_at: end of trading day t (as published); adjustment revisions carry their own known_at

candidates.pit_rule: rows with known_at > as_of ignored; trading calendar supplied explicitly; known_at is a timezone-aware datetime; version selection by (known_at, revision) with AmbiguousVersionError on unresolved conflicts
candidates.missing_rule: absent rows, None, NaN are skipped, never 0; < min_obs => None. CN: suspended days are missing, limit-up (+10%/+20%) days kept but flagged as censored in validation
candidates.direction_hypothesis: higher MAX => lower expected return (hypothesis only)
candidates.data_gaps: Needs corporate-action-adjusted PIT price history; not ingested in repo
candidates.definition_status: Prior-calendar-month definition checked in the Aug-2008 NYU working paper; published JFE 2011 text NOT available to this workstream
